# Nine Locks

## Overview

A stair of nine river locks, of which four are still worked and one is jammed.

## Geography

Rises about sixty feet over half a mile. Above the ninth lock the charts stop.

![[lock-stair-sketch.png]]

## The Jammed Gate (Session 2)

The fourth gate was wedged with green timber, which does not happen by accident.

## Current Status

Fourth gate open again. Log book still missing.

help.
